summary: Align the effect-utils Nix and source-member pins with fleet revision 7971b79c7bfac4196e506db3d09bdb4944d580aa, refresh the frozen TypeScript installation, and diagnose mismatched consumer overrides before building.

replay.detail: No claim or replay behavior change.

rules.detail: No checkpoint or fleet coordination change.

compatibility.detail: The TypeScript dependency pin now records the effect-utils source narHash alongside its output hash. Nix consumers must resolve effect-utils to fractal's pin; a different source fails evaluation with an actionable diagnostic rather than an installation hash mismatch. Buck root mirrors match the pinned producer. Runtime-input assertions are deferred until their check derivations are forced, so check-type discovery does not force the installation guard.

manual.detail: Align consumer effect-utils inputs with fractal's pin. After dependency inputs change, scripts/nix-typescript-client-deps-hash refreshes both the output hash and actual input narHash; it needs network and a builder for --system.

recovery.detail: Revert the input pins and dependency pin together to restore the previous packaging behavior.
